author: yashanktwt
text:
GTA 6 PC PORT UPDATE 🚨

While CGBJ has been taken down, a community launcher called MandyHub has emerged.

It fetches different PC port projects from PortWatch, compiles them locally, manages updates and offers graphics presets for AMD and NVIDIA users.

I've looked through the launcher's source code and found no obvious malware. However, it executes third-party code without sandboxing, so use it at your own risk.

ROCKSTAR'S GTA 6 PC CRACKDOWN IS ESCALATING — ANOTHER DEVELOPER GOES SILENT

A developer working on an unofficial GTA 6 PC port claims that Rockstar contacted him directly, prompting him to stop livestreaming his development work.

The developer, known as omonkey, reportedly told his Discord community that he would stop broadcasting his work to avoid risking legal action.

The important caveat: the alleged email from Rockstar has not been publicly verified, and we don't know what it actually said.
